subject: Reactive links in DiagrammeR or Rgraphviz graphs

messages.author: 30e0953620acde57
messages.subject: Reactive links in DiagrammeR or Rgraphviz graphs
parts:
Hi,

Is it possible to embed "interactive" links in the Rgraphvis or DiagrammeR graphs? The goal is to trigger an event which can be either captured in the Shiny app's server function or in the UI do show a pop-up menu, etc. I know that graphviz itself has this "URL attribute" which can be used to create interactive graphs (http://www.graphviz.org/content/output-formats#dimap). 

As an example, see the SchemaSpy application which uses this feature in its output: http://schemaspy.sourceforge.net/sample/relationships.html. All the blocks are clickable.

Thanks,
Alex
